findings.title: A Reroll that takes the trace back leaves the told copy behind, and its replay hands a second one
findings.where: scripts/murder-rules.mjs:2244-2247 (undoLastCrisis deletes the trace) with :2625-2627 (the replay's applyRemnant gives a new copy); scripts/cleanup.mjs:2211-2217 (undoLastCleanup deletes leftBehind) with :1082; scripts/reroll.mjs:2087-2090 (settleRemnant's remove)
findings.path: In an incident every crisis trace is told (shownToItsCast), so the killer's Hope or Despair strike gives the killer a copy at once. The killer (or the GM for them) Rerolls the strike: undoLastCrisis deletes the receipt's trace token, the copy on the killer's sheet stays (nothing takes it back), and the replay runs applyRemnant again, placing a new trace and giving a second copy (HELD is per token id, the new token is another). The killer ends with two Truth Bullets for one strike, one of a trace that no longer exists. The same for a Tamper replayed by its Reroll (leftBehind deleted, a new Tamper trace told again), and for a player's Search or Dynamic action told on Hope and Rerolled into no trace (retuneRemnant remove): the copy, named after the found item (subject), stays while the Reroll takes the item itself back. The module already takes back the analogous author's copy on a Reroll (reroll.mjs settleCleanup, E70 C12 takeBackAuthorsCopy); the told copy has no such road. The release notes only say a Reroll to Despair takes nothing back, which is the retune case, not the removal.
findings.fix: Where a Reroll or an undo deletes a trace (the three sites), also delete the sourceActor's own bullet whose secret remnantId is that token (as takeBackAuthorsCopy does: item.delete then dropSecret), or keep the told copy's item id on the receipt/bookmark and take it back there.
findings.refuter_why: No road takes a told copy back when its trace is deleted. undoLastCrisis deletes the receipt's token directly (murder-rules.mjs:2241-2249) and the replay runs applyRemnant again, which places a new token and, in an incident, tells it whatever the band (fromIncident), giving a second copy (:2625-2627); HELD in mintFindCopy is per token id, and the new token has a new id. The Tamper undo deletes leftBehind (cleanup.mjs:2211-2219) and its replay's dropRemnant carries told again (:1082). settleRemna
